name: Bachelor of Computing (Honours)
notes: COMP4550 must be completed twice in consecutive semesters; the consecutive-semester rule is not checked.
COMP4550 is also excluded from the 18-unit 4000-level pool so the two project enrolments are not counted there (the page only names COMP4500 and COMP4820 as excluded project courses).
The honours mark (HONS4700 Final Honours Grade: sum of mark x units / sum of units, NCN and WN counting as zero) is not calculated here.

Admission: an AQF Level 7 bachelor degree in a cognate discipline (Advanced Computing, Computer Science, Computing, Information Systems, Information Technology) completed within the last two years, with a weighted average equivalent to ANU 70% over the best 36 units of non-1000-level cognate courses; subject to supervisory capacity.
